title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
summary: On their fifth anniversary, Nick Dunne comes home to find his wife Amy missing and signs of a struggle. As police and the press close in, diary entries and his own account give conflicting pictures of the marriage.
readIf: you like a sharp, nasty, twist-heavy thriller about a marriage and the stories people tell.
skipIf: you want sympathetic characters; almost everyone is unpleasant.

pairings.reason: The author's debut: a bleaker, gothic mystery of a damaged reporter and a small town.
A lighter, more accessible read with another unreliable narrator.
Another mystery about suburban couples and hidden darkness, with more humour.
